instruction.name: xvhaddw.du.wu
instruction.description: Add odd-positioned unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` to even-positioned unsigned 32-bit elements in `b`, zero-extending both to 64-bit, to get the 64-bit result.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvhaddw.du.wu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvhaddw.du.wu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
